architectureDecisions: D1: Add `scm-review-delivery.js` as the application boundary and `github-scm-provider.js` as the first provider. DomainExecutionController remains execution/evidence authority and is not taught GitHub APIs.

D2: Select GitHub REST API `2026-03-10` as the production provider contract. Use Git database + refs + pulls + checks endpoints through built-in fetch; explicitly send API version and no raw provider response becomes acceptance by itself.

D3: One immutable review intent pins repository identity, target branch, exact baseSha, executionAttemptId, workspace result tree/digest, normalized changed paths, reviewKey and a deterministic provider branch derived from reviewKey. The branch is stable across repair iterations.

D4: Each candidate iteration pins candidateKey, parent/head expectation, resulting commit SHA, tree SHA and changed-path digest. Git blobs/tree/commit are created against the pinned parent; ref update is conditional on the observed expected head and never force-rebases an unknown branch.

D5: After any lost/ambiguous write acknowledgement, reconcile before mutating: read deterministic branch ref, inspect commit parent/tree/candidate marker, and discover open PR by exact head+base. Exact unique match is replay success; mismatch/multiple possibilities are BLOCKED.

D6: PR creation follows create-or-discover semantics learned from `peter-evans/create-pull-request`: stable head/base identity, exact lookup after an already-exists/ambiguous response and bounded retry only for known eventual-consistency reads. Never generate a new branch/PR identity merely because acknowledgement was lost.

D7: CI evidence is collected for the exact candidate commit SHA using GitHub check runs. Persist check-run id, check-suite id, app id/name, name, status, conclusion, started/completed times and details URL plus the queried head SHA.

D8: A pinned review policy declares required check names and optional expected app ids. PASS requires every required check for the exact current head to reach an allowed terminal success conclusion; failure yields REMEDIATION_REQUIRED and pending/missing/duplicate-ambiguous checks yield INCONCLUSIVE.
D9: Repair updates the same deterministic review branch with a new immutable candidate iteration. Old failing/passing check runs remain audit evidence but cannot satisfy the new head SHA.

D10: Re-read target-branch head and PR mergeability/currentness before reporting review readiness. Base movement, merge conflict or provider-required update is bounded repair/currentness evidence; BB-068 never auto-merges or bypasses branch protection.

D11: GitHub MCP Server v1.12.2 is an optional interaction adapter only. Its push/create tools and exact-head check lookup are useful patterns, but MCP tool output/versioning is not the canonical durable SCM effect contract.

D12: Keep provider-neutral artifact fields (`providerKind`, repositoryRef, reviewId, baseSha, headSha, ciRunId`) so GitLab can later map MR diff_refs/head pipeline SHA; implement GitHub only in BB-068.
implementationSlices: S1 — Contract + provider: define immutable review intent/candidate/CI evidence schemas and the narrow ScmReviewProvider; implement GitHub REST 2026-03-10 with exact base/ref/blob/tree/commit/PR/check identities and host-side credentials.

S2 — Idempotent effect recovery: deterministic review branch/reviewKey, conditional ref update, create-or-discover PR, read-after-write reconciliation and BLOCKED on mismatched/ambiguous provider state.

S3 — CI/currentness: collect required check runs only for exact candidate head; map fail→REMEDIATION_REQUIRED, pending/missing→INCONCLUSIVE, reject stale old-head evidence, and report base movement/conflict without merging.

S4 — Real probe: in a controlled GitHub repository create a candidate with a deliberate failing check, repair it to a new head, move the base branch, inject lost acknowledgement after PR creation, restart the process and prove exact replay/no duplicate review.

S5 — Consolidation: bind provider/version/token-permission profile, base/head/tree/path/PR/check identities, negative cases and live evidence into worker evidence; update Living Docs with the supported GitHub-only boundary and limitations.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A real GitHub candidate binds exact repository/base SHA, resulting commit and tree SHA, normalized changed paths, PR identity/head and exact check-run identities.
evidenceRequired: Real-provider receipt with repositoryRef, baseSha, headSha, treeSha, changedPaths digest, review id/url/head/base and exact check-run/check-suite/app identities.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A deliberate failing required check produces bounded remediation; only checks for the repaired current head may later satisfy the candidate, while stale checks and unrelated branch updates are rejected.
evidenceRequired: Two candidate heads with check evidence showing old-head failure cannot satisfy the repaired head, plus base-movement/unrelated-update negative evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: After lost provider acknowledgement, a fresh process discovers the exact existing branch/commit/PR or blocks on ambiguity; it never creates a duplicate review identity or bypasses merge policy.
evidenceRequired: Fault-injected post-write acknowledgement loss, fresh-process reconcile trace, stable reviewKey/branch/PR number and mutation counters proving no duplicate PR/unsafe ref update/merge.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: SCM/CI success cannot accept product truth, merge source or mutate domain publication authority.
evidenceRequired: Boundary tests proving review-ready output is evidence only and existing completion/publication authority remains required.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All SCM results are exact-source/currentness evidence; missing, stale or ambiguous provider state cannot be called success.
evidenceRequired: Negatives for wrong base/head/tree, missing checks, duplicate check identity, branch drift and ambiguous PR discovery.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: SCM credentials/mutation stay host-side behind the granted external capability; sandbox/repository text cannot widen provider permissions.

negativeVerificationCases: Provider returns success but observed branch head/tree differs from the pinned candidate.
A check run from the prior candidate SHA is reused to satisfy the repaired candidate.
A similarly named check from an unapproved app satisfies a pinned required check.
Base branch moves or PR becomes conflicting and the candidate is still reported current/merge-ready.
PR-create acknowledgement is lost and recovery creates a new branch/PR instead of discovering the existing effect.
Ambiguous branch/PR state triggers another mutation instead of BLOCKED.
SCM token appears in workspace, sandbox env/artifacts or persisted evidence.
SCM/CI ready state directly publishes product truth or performs merge.

livingDocs.statement: Living Docs describe the delivered GitHub SCM review-candidate boundary, exact SHA-bound CI evidence, lost-effect reconciliation, host credential/capability boundary and explicit no-merge/no-product-acceptance limitation.

researchBasis.selectionRule: Public GitHub examples used as architecture evidence have at least 1,000 stars; star count qualifies examples for inspection and is not correctness evidence.

selectedProvider.name: GitHub REST API
selectedProvider.rationale: ExHarness is hosted on GitHub; REST exposes exact git object/ref/PR/check identities and can be wrapped in a narrow deterministic provider without another lifecycle framework.

examples.observedPattern: Separate push/create-PR tools, restricted toolsets and PR check lookup by exact PR head SHA.
examples.conclusion: Useful optional interaction/security pattern; not the durable product effect authority because BB-068 requires explicit effect reconciliation and stable exact evidence contracts.

examples.observedPattern: Create-or-update uses stable head/base discovery; known post-create 422 eventual-consistency reads use targeted retry.
examples.conclusion: Adopt deterministic head/base discovery and bounded known-error retry for lost acknowledgement; do not blindly retry unknown mutations.

examples.observedPattern: Mature automation separates change generation/PR lifecycle from CI-status gating and uses scoped platform permissions.
examples.conclusion: Borrow lifecycle/least-privilege pattern only; reject dependency because its product scope and AGPL runtime footprint are unnecessary for this bounded provider.

parity.gitlab: Future adapter can map provider-neutral review/base/head/CI fields to Merge Request diff_refs.head_sha and pipeline.sha; no GitLab implementation is authorized in BB-068.

operations: collectChecks(reviewId,headSha) -> exact check identities bound to headSha
providerContract.mutationRule: Every mutation is preceded/followed by exact observation. Unknown outcome is reconciled by deterministic identities before any retry.
providerContract.secretBoundary: Credential resolver is host-side only; provider receives no credential from workspace/model payload and persists no secret.
providerContract.authority: Provider can mutate the granted repository branch/review only; it has no merge, product publication or acceptance method.

candidateContract.repair: A repair is a new immutable candidate iteration on the same review intent/branch; old iterations remain evidence.

reconciliationContract.branch: Read deterministic ref. Exact candidateKey/tree/parent match => replay; expected predecessor => one conditional update; any other head => BLOCKED.
reconciliationContract.review: Discover open review by exact repository+head branch+base. Unique exact head match => replay. Already-exists/known eventual-consistency => bounded rediscovery. Conflicting/multiple/mismatched result => BLOCKED.
reconciliationContract.checks: Check evidence is valid only when provider-reported check head equals current candidate head; no name-only carry-forward across SHAs.
reconciliationContract.failure: Transport timeout after a possible mutation is UNKNOWN_EFFECT until reconciliation proves exact effect or BLOCKED ambiguity.

dependencyContract.research: BB-066/BB-067 READY plans are PLANNED_DEPENDENCY evidence only.
dependencyContract.worker: BB-066 and BB-067 must both be DONE. Consume their delivered runtime/workspace, host capability gateway and credential boundary without redefining them.
dependencyContract.oracle: No packages/oracle implementation exists at research baseline. BB-068 must not fabricate Oracle delivery or write packages/oracle; provider boundary stays compatible with later source-IO ownership.
